name: Acceptance suite-3 test 86 - partial wildcard in a Service principal is invalid (fail closed)
note: IAM-1006 (Phase 10, iteration 4) adversarial finding: partial-wildcard fail-closed was scoped to the AWS Principal key only, so a never-matching Service member (ec2-*.amazonaws.com) was presented as a normal, complete service trust with coverage.incomplete=false. An AWS Service principal is an EXACT identifier; the element does not wildcard-match, so the globbed member matches no service and must fail closed exactly like a wildcard AWS Principal ARN. The valid member (lambda.amazonaws.com) still stands as an informational TRUST-SERVICE; the invalid member is located at Principal.Service[1] and marks coverage incomplete with INVALID_PRINCIPAL_WILDCARD_ARN.
